name: Tönisvorst (Germany)
description: White field with a blue inverted triangle issuing from the top edge, bearing the yellow tau cross of the city arms of Tönisvorst.
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Düsseldorf of 22 June 1972 the then municipality of Tönisvorst, a city since 27 March 1979, was granted the right to bear a flag.
